name: TokenVault
description: Scheduled token release with halving. Fungible CashTokens sit in a covenant next to a state NFT; the fund releases up to the current block height, the reward halves every period, and the template computes the next state NFT.

fund.name: Fund
fund.description: Holds the fund key. Signs every mint and release; the released tokens are paid to this key.

fundMint.name: Fund the mint
fundMint.description: Send satoshis to the TokenVault_Mint covenant. Output 0 of this transaction becomes the token genesis.

mint.name: Mint and lock
mint.description: Create the token category and lock the supply in the vault with its first state NFT.

release.name: Release tokens
release.description: Release tokens up to a block height. Spends the token coin, the state NFT and one wallet coin; pays the fund, returns the rest with the next state NFT.

finalRelease.name: Release the remainder
finalRelease.description: End of life: the schedule releases everything that is left. The vault and its state NFT end.

prepareFeeCoin.name: Prepare a fee coin
prepareFeeCoin.description: Make one plain coin at output 0 of its transaction. A release spends it as its fee coin: the contract names the next state NFT after it.

reclaim.name: Reclaim the mint coin
reclaim.description: Spend an unused mint coin back to the fund wallet.

sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.description: Send satoshis from the fund wallet to another address.

mintTransaction.name: Minted and locked
mintTransaction.description: Minted the supply and locked it in the vault.

releaseTransaction.name: Tokens released
releaseTransaction.description: Released tokens from the vault to the fund.

finalReleaseTransaction.name: Vault emptied
finalReleaseTransaction.description: Released the remainder; the vault ended.

reclaimTransaction.name: Mint coin reclaimed
reclaimTransaction.description: Moved the mint coin back to the fund wallet.

prepareFeeCoinTransaction.name: Fee coin prepared
prepareFeeCoinTransaction.description: Made a plain coin at output 0.

mintCoinInput.name: Mint coin
mintCoinInput.description: The funded TokenVault_Mint coin; its transaction hash becomes the token category.

vaultTokenInput.name: Vault token coin
vaultTokenInput.description: The fungible tokens locked in the vault.

vaultStateInput.name: Vault state NFT
vaultStateInput.description: The state NFT: release height, halving height and reward.

walletInput.name: Fee coin
walletInput.description: A plain coin of the fund wallet that pays the fee; the payout is built on it.

mintFundingOutput.name: Mint coin
mintFundingOutput.description: Satoshis locked to the TokenVault_Mint covenant.

mintVaultTokens.name: Vault tokens
mintVaultTokens.description: The supply locked in the vault.

mintChange.name: Change
mintChange.description: The rest of the mint coin back to the fund wallet.

releasePayout.name: Released tokens
releasePayout.description: The released tokens, paid to the fund.

releaseVaultState.name: Vault state
releaseVaultState.description: The next state NFT, computed by the template.

finalPayout.name: Remaining tokens
finalPayout.description: Every token that is left, paid to the fund.

reclaimOutput.name: Reclaimed
reclaimOutput.description: The mint coin returned to the fund wallet.

sweepOutput.name: Recipient
sweepOutput.description: Satoshis sent out of the fund wallet.

walletCoin.name: Fee coin
walletCoin.description: A plain coin of the fund wallet.

walletReceive.name: Receive
walletReceive.description: Satoshis received into the fund wallet.

walletChange.name: Change
walletChange.description: Change returned to the fund wallet.

fundWallet.name: Fund wallet
fundWallet.description: Pay to public key hash of the fund key.

mintContract.name: TokenVault_Mint
mintContract.description: The original mint covenant: one genesis input, three outputs, tokens locked as the fund chooses.

vault.name: TokenVault_Release
vault.description: The original release covenant with this halving length. Holds the token coin and the state NFT.

recipient.name: Recipient
recipient.description: Any locking script chosen by the sender.

minerFee.name: Miner fee
minerFee.description: Satoshis left to miners by a covenant transaction.

fundKey.name: Fund key
fundKey.description: The private key of the fund. Its public key is a constructor argument of both covenants.

halvingLength.name: Halving length
halvingLength.description: Blocks between reward halvings (constructor argument of the vault).

tokenCategory.name: Token category
tokenCategory.description: The category of the vault token and its state NFT.

stateCategory.name: State NFT category
stateCategory.description: The category of the state NFT being spent. Equal to the token category until the first release.

nextStateCategory.name: Next state NFT category
nextStateCategory.description: The transaction hash of the fee coin: the next state NFT is a genesis on it.

releaseHeight.name: Release height
releaseHeight.description: First field of the state NFT being spent: the height releases continue from.

halvingHeight.name: Halving height
halvingHeight.description: Second field of the state NFT being spent: the height the current halving period started at.

currentReward.name: Current reward
currentReward.description: Third field of the state NFT being spent: tokens released per block now.

blockHeight.name: Release up to
blockHeight.description: Release up to this block height. Must not exceed the chain height.

vaultTokens.name: Vault tokens
vaultTokens.description: Fungible token amount on the vault token coin being spent.

walletSatoshis.name: Fee coin value
walletSatoshis.description: Satoshis on the wallet coin that pays the fee.

mintSatoshis.name: Mint coin value
mintSatoshis.description: Satoshis sent to the mint covenant.

mintCoinSatoshis.name: Mint coin value
mintCoinSatoshis.description: Satoshis on the mint coin being spent.

lockAmount.name: Locked supply
lockAmount.description: Fungible tokens minted and locked in the vault.

startHeight.name: Start height
startHeight.description: Block height the release schedule starts at.

reward.name: Initial reward
reward.description: Tokens released per block before the first halving.

coinSatoshis.name: Coin value
coinSatoshis.description: Satoshis in each prepared fee coin.
